description:
Join ClearEdge and become part of a collaborative team that supports some of the DoD’s most critical technical missions. Our corporate professionals play a vital role in enabling our engineers, customers, and partners to succeed by providing operational excellence, strategic support, and innovative business solutions across the organization.

ClearEdge offers an extremely competitive benefits package—including a $10k annual training and education benefit, a 10% 401(k) contribution fully vested on day one, and annual health and technology allowances. Learn more at www.clearedgeit.com/careers/



Your Mission
Support and maintain ClearEdge’s secure IT environment, ensuring systems, networks, and user services remain reliable, available, and compliant with security requirements. You will perform hands-on systems administration, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, assist employees with technical support, and maintain the infrastructure that keeps daily operations running. This role is ideal for a cleared IT professional with a strong Windows and networking foundation who enjoys solving problems, supporting users, and maintaining a secure technology environment.

You Will Excel In This Role If You:

 Have a solid foundation in Windows systems administration, networking, and IT support

 Enjoy troubleshooting technical issues and helping users resolve hardware, software, and connectivity problems

 Understand the importance of security controls, account management, and secure IT operations

 Are comfortable supporting both infrastructure systems and day-to-day end-user technology needs

 Take initiative, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate technical documentation

 Communicate effectively with users, technical teammates, and leadership

 Can manage multiple support requests and priorities while providing responsive, professional service


A Day In The Life Of:

 Administer and maintain Windows servers, workstations, user accounts, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP

 Provide help desk and desktop support for hardware, software, account access, printing, and connectivity issues

 Troubleshoot network and infrastructure issues involving switches, firewalls, and enterprise connectivity

 Install, configure, update, and maintain computer equipment, operating systems, applications, and peripherals

 Support virtualization platforms, shared drives, file permissions, storage systems, and other corporate IT services

 Maintain security controls, access permissions, endpoint protection, system updates, and backups in accordance with company policies

 Monitor system availability and performance, investigate technical issues, and coordinate escalations when needed

 Maintain accurate records of support requests, system configurations, IT assets, and technical procedures

 Assist with infrastructure upgrades, equipment deployments, onboarding, offboarding, and other IT operational tasks

 Follow applicable security policies and compliance requirements, including relevant NIST and CMMC standards

 Support occasional after-hours maintenance, upgrades, and major system updates to minimize disruption to business operations


What We Are Expecting From You:

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field

 Minimum of three years of experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure, desktop support, or IT operations

 Active TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph

 CompTIA Security+ certification, or ability to obtain the certification within 90 days of starting

 Experience administering Windows systems, including Active Directory, Group Policy, user accounts, and file permissions

 Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, and wireless connectivity

 Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, and end-user technical issues

 Familiarity with enterprise security practices, access controls, patching, endpoint protection, and system compliance

 Strong customer service, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

 Ability to document technical issues, follow established procedures, and manage multiple priorities

 Availability for occasional after-hours support during major system updates, maintenance, and infrastructure changes

 Availability for occasional after-hours emergency support during unplanned system outages or system issues 

 Ability to work full-time onsite


Nice To Haves: 

 Familiarity with Linux administration and command-line tools

 Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, ESXi, or vSphere

 Experience with firewalls, network monitoring, or network security technologies

 Familiarity with network-attached storage, iSCSI, and shared file systems

 Experience supporting macOS devices in an enterprise environment

 Familiarity with endpoint protection and anti-malware platforms

 Experience with telephony systems, printers, and other office technology

 Experience supporting backups, disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring

 Additional IT certifications relevant to systems administration, networking, or cybersecurity


ClearEdge is an established small business that values its employees and is committed to providing an environment where individuals can succeed and grow. We believe in developing our people, promoting from within, and fostering long-term career growth across the organization.

Our Core Values—Honesty, Integrity, Loyalty, Fairness, Respect, Responsibility, and Accountability—guide everything we do. These principles shape our culture, inform our decisions, and drive our commitment to excellence in support of our customers and partners.

If this position is not the right fit, we encourage you to visit our Careers page to explore other opportunities at ClearEdge or connect with one of our recruiters at careers@clearedgeit.com. ClearEdge is an equal opportunity employer.
